verses.english: “Someone with three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there. …

verses.pali: asucinā kāyakammena, asucinā vacīkammena, asucinā manokammena—
verses.english: Impure deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …
Someone with three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there. …

verses.pali: sucinā kāyakammena, sucinā vacīkammena, sucinā manokammena—
verses.english: Pure deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …”

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
